findings.description: The regex check changed from match() to fullmatch(), so a pattern now has to match the entire exception message instead of just its beginning.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception with str "Connection refused". The old self.match.match(...) returned True, but fullmatch returns None, so the predicate is False and the exception is not retried. This silently changes behavior for every existing caller that relies on prefix matching, and those callers stop retrying transient errors without any error being raised.
